verdict.rationale: Mistral Document AI is an API service, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers API key creation, permission scoping, or per-agent credentials. On-prem deployment, the Trust Center and the SDKs are adjacent features and do not show scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
